==Description==
The '''Knight''', internally referred to as '''Knight Plush''', is an enemy that appears in [[Pizza Party]]. It has a decent amount of health and a fast speed. It is also a [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemy, meaning only towers with lead detection can damage it. It has one ability, where it targets one tower in its range and stuns it for a few seconds.

==Appearance==
The '''Knight''' wears white and grey fully body armor, with a purple cape. It wields a wooden sword and holds a wooden shield with poorly plastered orange and purple panels. While running, it holds up its shield in front of it with its left arm. It has grey eyes.

==Strategy==
*High DPS towers with lead detection, like the [[Accelerator]], [[Engineer]] or [[Pursuit]] are quite effective against this.
**Multiple early-game oriented towers, like the [[Brawler]] or [[Trapper]] can also be useful against it.
**The [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give all your towers lead detection for a brief period of time.
*The [[Medic]] can be used to block towers from the '''Knight's''' stuns.

==Trivia==
*The '''Knight''' originates from the [[Lunar Overture Event]].
*Unlocking the '''Knight's''' [[Logboosk|Logbook]] does not grant you to summon the [[Knight (Solar Eclipse)|Knight]] from the [[Solar Eclipse Event]].
**This is because it is internally called the ''Knight Plush'' and not the ''Knight''.
